s.note: the biscuits sent to the troops
s.how: Mix 100g oats, 150g flour, 80g coconut and 120g brown sugar. Melt 125g butter with 2 tbsp golden syrup, add 1 tsp bicarb in 2 tbsp boiling water and stir through. Roll balls and bake at 170C for 12 minutes.

s.note: the light horse camp in the desert
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 450g self-raising flour, add 300ml milk and shape a round. Bake at 200C for 30 minutes until it sounds hollow. Serve warm with butter and golden syrup.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced chuck. Add a chopped onion, 2 carrots, 2 potatoes and 750ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2 hours until tender. Serve with damper.

w.how: Rub 50g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 1 egg and a little milk. Drop spoonfuls into a simmering sauce of 150g golden syrup, 100g brown sugar and 500ml water and cook covered 20 minutes.

d.note: the billy on the campfire before Beersheba
d.how: Boil 1.2L water, add 6 tea bags and let it stew for 5 minutes. Pour into mugs with milk and sugar. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
